snippet.title: 🇯🇵 Tantei Shinshi DASH! (探偵紳士ＤＡＳＨ！) VN | SEGA Dreamcast Gameplay
snippet.description:
Gameplay sample from SEGA #Dreamcast version.
Tantei Shinshi Dash is more of an adventure game than a spotty teenagers dream girly adventure. Tantei Shinshi Dash starts you off in the room belonging to a down and out detective mulling over what a dull and sad life he has.  unless you understand Japanese you won't get any of it.
